heading: Where to Find Us on Island
note: Uncle Mimi's baked goods are made in small batches and delivered fresh, so the selection at each store varies by day and season. To be sure of a specific item, call the store or reach out to us before you visit.

image.alt: The weathered cedar-shingle storefront of the Chilmark General Store, with an “OPEN” chalkboard sign on the front steps.
The bright interior of the Katama General Store, with fresh produce displays and a coffee counter.
The hanging “North Tisbury Farm & Market” sign with a rooster weathervane motif, above a bed of summer wildflowers under a blue sky.
